description_en: Queries the zones that are available for an Enterprise Edition transit router in a specified region
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口查询指定地域下企业版转发路由器支持的可用区信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --support-multicast false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterAvailableResource

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the Enterprise Edition transit router is deployed.

Call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain region IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
企业版转发路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Enterprise Edition transit router is deployed.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to obtain region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to query only information about zones that support the multicast feature.

- **true**: Yes.

  If you enable this feature and the **ListTransitRouterAvailableResource** operation returns an empty response, it indicates that Enterprise Edition transit routers in the current region do not support the multicast feature.

- **false** (default): No.
parameters.description_zh:
是否只查询支持组播功能的可用区的信息。

- **true**：是。

    开启查询功能后，如果**ListTransitRouterAvailableResource**接口返回结果为空，则表示当前地域的企业版转发路由器不支持组播功能。
- **false**（默认值）：否。
